column2: Certificate in Quantitative Methods
column16: Applicants must be a current UC San Diego graduate student.
column47: The Department of Political Science offers a Certificate in Quantitative Methods, which is open to all graduate students at UC San Diego. The certificate program gives students from a variety of disciplines rigorous training in statistics and formal modeling. In addition to a core curriculum of courses on statistical modeling, research design, and formal theory, the certificate offers students a choice of elective courses on such advanced topics as causal inference, Bayesian statistics, experimental design, spatial data analysis, computational modeling, and network analysis. Students complete the certificate with a two-course capstone research project. The certificate requires a minimum of nine courses (36 units). Course requirements for the Certificate are independent of graduate degree requirements. Courses taken to satisfy requirements for the Certificate may be applied toward graduate degree requirements, with the approval of the student's home department. All requirements for the Certificate must be completed prior to or at the same time as the student's graduate degree.

column2: Certificate in Spatial Analysis
column38: Herbert Wertheim School of Public Health and Human Longevity Science
column47: The Certificate in Spatial Analysis provides graduate students at UC San Diego with a specialized set of skills and a credential that will enable them to compete for jobs in the growing fields of spatial data analysis, geographic information systems, and data science. Spatial data analysis is an interdisciplinary field of research that offers a powerful set of methods and techniques for analyzing spatial patterns in data—whether for research or commercial use. These methods are relevant to a variety of disciplines, including urban planning, public health, environmental studies, political science, economics, sociology, and engineering. The certificate can be earned by students in any graduate program at UC San Diego. It is also available to individuals who are not enrolled in a UC San Diego graduate program through UC San Diego Extension’s Concurrent Registration process.

column2: Certificate in Event Safety
column47: The Event Safety Certificate provides a comprehensive education in event safety and security, from initial risk assessment to emergency planning and crisis response. Developed by industry leaders, this program addresses the unique safety challenges of both indoor and outdoor events, including concerts, sporting events, festivals, and conventions. You will learn to identify potential hazards, develop effective safety plans, and manage on-site security operations. The curriculum emphasizes real-world scenarios and practical skills, preparing you to ensure the safety and well-being of attendees, staff, and performers. By the end of the program, you will be equipped to lead safety initiatives, comply with regulatory standards, and mitigate risks in any event environment.

column2: Certificate in Professional Safety and Health Officer
column47: The Professional Safety and Health Officer certificate program is a unique program designed for individuals who want to start a career in the safety and health field or for those who have safety and health responsibilities and want to take their knowledge and skills to the next level. The program is taught by practicing safety and health professionals and it gives participants the opportunity to build a strong safety and health foundation with a focus on leadership and management skills. This program covers the technical, managerial and leadership skills needed to be an effective safety and health professional. This program covers a wide range of topics, including fundamentals of occupational safety and health, safety and health management systems, risk management, leadership, and communication.
column50: This program has been approved by the Board of Certified Safety Professionals for Continuance of Certification (COC) points.

column2: Certificate in Safety and Health Specialist
column47: Safety and health specialists play a crucial role in preventing harm to workers, property, the environment, and the general public. They are responsible for a wide range of duties, from developing and implementing safety programs to conducting inspections and audits. They also work to ensure that all applicable laws and regulations are followed. The Safety and Health Specialist certificate is designed for those who have a role in the safety and health function in their organization, are looking to enter the safety and health field, or those who want to expand their knowledge of the field. The program emphasizes management and leadership skills in addition to technical knowledge. Students in this program will learn the tools and techniques needed to be a successful safety and health specialist. They will also gain the skills and knowledge needed to meet the challenges of the profession. This program is ideal for those who are passionate about safety and want to make a difference in the lives of others.
column50: Our program has been reviewed by the Board of Certified Safety Professionals (BCSP) and determined to be an acceptable program for those wishing to achieve the Certified Safety Professional (CSP) designation. This certificate is approved for the Cal/OSHA Training requirement for the Construction Safety and Health specialist.

column2: Certificate in Safety and Health Fundamentals
column47: The Safety and Health Fundamentals Certificate Program is a unique program that provides a solid foundation in workplace safety and health. The program is ideal for those entering the safety profession, as well as experienced professionals looking to enhance their knowledge-base and skills. The curriculum provides both introductory and in-depth coverage of topics that are essential for today’s safety professionals. Courses are taught by experienced safety and health professionals who are experts in their respective fields. Required courses are part of the curriculum for the Professional Certificate in Occupational Safety and Health.
